documents.title: Stolbovan rauhan vuonna 1617 raja nykyiseltä valtakunnanrajalta Suolammelle
documents.publicationCitation: Faravid 11 (1987), pp. 95-118; National Library of Finland Arto catalogue record 012568827.
documents.notes: The catalogue record is explicitly devoted to the 1617 Stolbovo boundary and the National Library copy is described as illustrated with maps. It provides a concrete specialist reconstruction target for the unresolved boundary, but is secondary evidence and is not a substitute for primary treaty/demarcation material or controlled production georeferencing.

documents.title: Public electronic holdings of the National Archive of the Republic of Tuva: Tuvan People's Republic corpus
documents.institution: National Archive of the Republic of Tuva
authority: National Archive of the Republic of Tuva
documents.publicationCitation: National Archive of the Republic of Tuva, public electronic funds and geospatial document catalogue.
documents.notes: The archive states that its public system contains digitized TNR-era archival documents and provides geographic indexing of digital objects. This establishes a concrete authoritative archival corpus for continuity/boundary research, but the exact 1944 external boundary still requires identification of specific map/survey records and controlled spatial validation.
